entities.name: main road (the outer road east, from the palm-covered carts to the moorings)
entities.what: The outer road continues east from S4 part 1 as a broad bare-earth street: between the two palm-covered family carts, past the open shop hall with its tables and the big roof by the crowd on its north side, across the mouth of the open square that runs north to the top street (the crossroads, with the horse and donkeys and the wheelwright), past the wheelwright's shed and the big trees, then along the front of the tea house's terrace with the long row of big tiled roofs on its south side, to the stall and the willows by the moorings. No edge, kerb or paving is drawn; it is bare earth.
entities.vis: part: south half hidden behind the south row's roofs east of u 13250; east end hidden
entities.note: No road edge or centre line is drawn anywhere; every point except the datum is est, read from where the open ground stops. DATUM: centre point 0 is exactly (12600,1206), S4.road.main's centre interpolated between part 1's (12500,1200) and (12750,1215) (station +67.95); the second point repeats S4's (12750,1215). edge_n starts at S4's 972.5 and edge_s at S4's 1484 (both kept). EDGE_N, west to east: the front edge of the official hall's raised floor (S4.bld.official_hall_12530, v 953-970) to u ~12940; the front of S4b.bld.shop_hall_13170 (its front table legs at v ~965 at 13000 and ~1060 at 13300; the sedan chair and the first palm-covered cart stand on the road in front of it); its south-east corner ~(13390,1072); straight across the mouth of the open square (S4b.road.cross_13530) to the wheelwright's yard (~13700,1005); the foot of the stand with the big round basket (~13800,985); the shed's south post (13965,1031); the foot of the big tree (~14010,1090); then the front edge of the tea house's raised terrace (structures_e: (14118,1032)->(14300,1145)->(14420,1150)->(14450,1180)->(14700,1195)); its east end est ~(14920,1205); the foot of the stall under the willows (~15100,1150); the willows' bases on the bank (est 1250-1300, hidden behind the roofs). EDGE_S, west to east: the north end of S4.bld.south_hall_12350 (S4's 1484, kept), then down its east side along the open front's columns (12690-12700 and 12760-12770, feet est ~1700) to the silk's bottom edge: east of the hall the open ground runs off the bottom of the silk (the horse, the people at the second cart's rear and the cart's wheel stand at v 1600-1790), so the edge there is the silk's edge (beyond the painting). From u ~13240 the north walls of the south row, all hidden behind their own roofs and est as in part 1 (under the nearest roof line, or the north gable peak plus ~5 m): the small gable roof S4b.bld.south_gable_shed_13380 (~1700), the big hall S4b.bld.south_hall_13920 (its west side ~1690 at u 13600, its north end ~1475 under the north gable peak (14145,1080)), the small hipped building S4b.bld.south_hip_roof_13810 in front of it (north wall est ~1390; a man stands on the road just behind it), structures_e's long hall (S4b.bld.south_hall_long_14680, north wall est ~1440-1455 under its ridge at v 1240-1265, u 14100-15212) and its east gable foot (15262,1460), then the north end of structures_e's diagonal hall (S4b.bld.south_hall_diagonal_15242, north gable peak (15500,1304), north side est ~1600). Low confidence everywhere east of u 13240. CENTRE: drawn through the traffic about midway between the edges: between the first cart (wheels ~1210) and the second cart (front ~1430) at u 12900-13100, between the horse group (hooves 1060-1110) and the oxen (hooves 1400-1500) at 13300-13500; east of u 14000 the visible open strip between the tea house's terrace (1150-1200) and the south row's ridges (1240-1265) is only the road's north part (the two men at u 15075-15125 stand with their feet est ~1260 just behind the long hall's ridge), so the centre is est behind the ridge. EAST END (u 15200-15500): the ground is hidden by the south row's roofs and the willows. Taken as structures_e's reading (2): the road bends south-east between the long hall's east gable (15262) and the low house behind the willow (S4b.bld.house_behind_willow_15414, ridge v 1212-1220, south front est ~1440-1475), passes behind the diagonal hall's north gable and runs on along the front of S3's long riverside hall, whose veranda railing is at v ~1420-1470 at u 15530-15650 with an open strip in front of it at ~1480-1520 (seen at zoom 0.55 to u 16300). The willows' feet (t5: S4b.tree.willow_15468 est (15468,1300), S4b.tree.young_tree_15275 est (15275,1330)) are then north of the road. The last centre point (15500,1530) is S3's datum: S3's mapper should check it against the hall's front and S3's own road. Other reading (structures_e's (1)): the road keeps north of the low house among the willows at v ~1150-1220; it would then run into S3's riverside hall (which fills v ~950-1470 from u 15530), so it is not taken. The strokes do not settle it: conf low. MERGE: edge_n's "stall under the willows (~15100)" is the frame carried by S4b.fig.man_frame_or_hat_15125, not a stall; the point stays the ground behind the road pair.

entities.name: open square running north from the main road to the top street (the first crossroads)
entities.what: A wide open earth square that leaves the main road northward between the east end of the shop hall and the wheelwright's shed and climbs the silk to the top street: the crowd round the seated man stands at its north-west corner under the big roof's awning, the saddled horse and the donkeys with their men at its mouth, the wheelwright and his men at the wheel lying on the ground and the pole frame with the hanging basket on its east side, mules walking at its north end where it meets the top street. No edge or paving is drawn.
entities.src: 张安治: the first crossroads (sections.md S4)
entities.note: Runs south to north. MEETS THE MAIN ROAD across its mouth at u ~13390-13700 (v ~1005-1072, the main road's edge_n). LEAVES THE SILK: it does not; at v ~400-470 it opens into the top street (S4b.road.top_street_13700), which runs east-north-east along the top of the silk. EDGE_W: the shop hall's east end (corner post 13385, its south-east corner est ~(13392,1072)), the east edge of the big roof's mat awning ((13330,730), over the seated man), then the front of the shop behind the crowd (S4b.bld.crowd_shop_13180, ~(13290,420)). EDGE_E: the wheelwright's yard (the wheel 13565-13752 v 755-797 and the timber pile at 13650-13800 v 790-870 lie inside the square), the west side of S4b.bld.wheelwright_shed_13840 (its north-west top at (13715,470)), and the big tree's trunk at ~13790. It is wider than a lane (~300 px across), an open square more than a street. Identification of the crossroads is the scholars' (张安治, sections.md:100-101); the strokes show open ground here, no buildings.

entities.name: top street along the top of the silk (shops and eating houses on its north side)
entities.what: A street running east-north-east across the top of the silk from the crowd's square past a long row of open-fronted shops and eating houses with tables and benches on its north side, mules and donkeys walking on it, toward the bank above the moorings. Bare earth, no edge drawn.
entities.vis: part: under willow and tree branches; east end beyond u 14150 read at zoom 1 only
entities.note: Runs west to east. EDGE_N: the fronts of S4b.bld.crowd_shop_13180 and S4b.bld.top_street_shops_13580 (their front sill (13530,247)->(13790,160), slope -0.33), then S4b.bld.top_open_shop_13990 (front sill (13880,150)->(14105,118)), then the small building at u ~14400-14550 (v ~200-320). EDGE_S: west of u 13700 the square (S4b.road.cross_13530) opens south, so the edge is drawn across its mouth; then the wheelwright shed's north end (13715,470), the big tree at ~13800, the north side of S4b.bld.roof_behind_trees_13980 (hidden behind its roof, est), the big willow at u ~14200-14250. EAST END: at u ~14450 (v ~370) it reaches the bank above the moorings where three figures stand (u 14540-14700, v 330-410); the bank path beyond is the river agent's. Recorded whole here because its middle is in structures_w's range; structures_e and the river agent: please don't record it again (merge note).

entities.name: open shop hall east of the official hall (eating house with tables and a signboard)
entities.what: Single-storey open-fronted hall at road level, the eastern bays of the long building whose western bays are the official hall: one continuous tiled roof with a dark band (a hanging valance or a low mat pent eave) under its eave from u ~12560 to the hipped east end at u ~13385; thin posts and a lintel along the front; inside, long tables and benches (an eating or tea shop: the tile agents' props) and partitions or shelves at the back, with a slanted board or rack at u 13227-13274 (v 861-904); a light signboard hangs on the front between two posts at u 13040-13080 with writing in about three short columns, every character illegible at the scan's resolution (□□□…).
entities.vis: part: front bases behind the first palm-covered cart and the sedan chair; back behind the tables
entities.note: ROOF: tiles from v ~700 (where the big roof behind, S4b.bld.big_roof_hall_12990, covers its top) down to the tile eave at v ~777-783; under it a dark horizontal band v ~783-837 (restyle: a blue cloth valance); a lintel at v ~840-845. The roof is the SAME unbroken roof as S4.bld.official_hall_12530's (no break, gable or step anywhere between 12560 and 13385): this entity is only its bays east of part 1's est east end (sw at part 1's se corner (12960,975), nw at its ne (13000,800)), so the builder should join the two roofs without a seam (seam note on S4.bld.official_hall_12530 in the report). EAST END: the tile roof ends in a hip, its edge (13313,780)->(13337,777); the dark band's corner at (13385,832); a corner post at u ~13385 (t2 reads this east end as a small tiled shed, roof v 760-842, posts ~13290 and ~13380, under which the counter man leans: here the hall's last bay). POSTS (seen from the lintel down, feet hidden): 12978/12999 (a pair at the hall/shop junction), 13040 and 13077 (the signboard between them), 13104/13122, 13170, 13187, 13230, 13248, 13272-13282, 13300, 13385; the thicker front ones are given as bays (feet est on the front line). Base est: front line from part 1's se corner (12960,975) to the east end, where the front tables' legs reach v ~1060 at u 13300 and a man stands at (13360,1090) at the corner; back est as part 1's (v ~800) rising to ~830 at the east end. SIGNBOARD: a light board u 13040-13080, v 840-890, hung on the front between the posts at 13040 and 13077, with about three columns of dark marks; unreadable even on a zoom-8 crop (the restyle draws illegible pseudo-characters). Furniture inside (t1/t2 props): table A top u 12950-13074 (v 898-937), table B 13145-13290 (v 905-932), table C 13217-13320 (v 953-985, legs to ~1060), benches. SCALE CUES (px): lintel 842 to table C's leg feet 1060 ≈ 218; table C front edge 985 to its feet 1060 ≈ 75; signboard 40 × 50. DEPTH DIRECTION (ground level, furniture): table A's sides (13036,898)->(13074,936) and (12952,912)->(12976,936), slope +1.0; table B's left side (13145,907)->(13173,932), +0.89; table C's left side (13217,953)->(13253,983), +0.83: the tables recede up to the LEFT here (see the receding-edge table in the report). MERGE: t2 recorded the signboard as a prop, S4b.prop.signboard_13060 (retired as a duplicate of this building's board): a framed board u 13041-13080, v 845-888, three columns of illegible characters, a rail under it at v 888-896 and two thin uprights below it at u ~13054 and ~13068 down to v ~950. t2's other reading is a free-standing signboard on those two legs, inside the shop; structures_w and t1 read it hung on the front between the posts at 13040 and 13077 (kept). Built once, with the hall.

entities.name: big tiled roof behind the shop hall (the big roof by the crowd)
entities.what: A very large tiled roof rising behind (north of) the shop hall's roof: its top at u ~12990 behind the big gnarled tree's trunk, its east edge running straight down to the right to where the shop hall's roof covers it; under its lower west part the open framing of a gable or eave shows (a tie beam, a post, diagonal rafters); a mat awning (lattice-textured strip) runs along its east edge down to u ~13340 and shades the seated man at the crowd; walls and base hidden behind the shop hall.
entities.vis: part: west half behind the willows and the pines, base behind the shop hall, top behind a tree trunk
entities.src: sections.md S4: a crowd round a seated man under an awning (≈ 13100-13450)
entities.note: ROOF: tile rows run diagonally from upper left to lower right; top at ~(12990,380) (the tree trunk at 13000-13060 covers it); east edge (12990,380)->(13250,620)->(13300,700), slope ~+0.92; its west part shows only through the willow whips as two rows of tile ends at (12700-12790, v 335-370) and (12750-12830, v 465-545) - these are part 1's "roofs behind the pines" (map/index.md: not yet mapped), recorded here, not as separate buildings; the restyle paints only willow there. Under the lower west part, at u 12930-13075 (v 580-690): open framing, a tie beam at v ~690, a short post at ~12945 and diagonal rafters (restyle: an open gable truss). AWNING: a strip of lattice texture (a mat, not tiles) along the east edge from (13123,453) to (13337,727), about 40-60 px wide; no poles of its own are drawn, so it is taken as hung from this roof (if the tile agent t2 records it as a prop, keep one). Under it the seated man (~13240-13290, v 520-620) and the dark patterned shape before him (t2). FORM UNRESOLVED: either a hip-gable roof whose ridge runs E-W at v ~350-380 (the tile rows through the willows) with its east hip running down to the right, or a N-S roof seen from the west (its east edge then a receding verge, slope +0.92, matching the shop tables' up-left receding). It may also be the main roof of the long official hall/shop hall building, the shop hall's roof being its front pent roof. Base is a placeholder directly behind the shop hall (builder choice). SCALE CUES: none (no door or post shows).

entities.name: far diamond-tiled roof behind the two straight trees (top left)
entities.what: A large roof of diamond-patterned tiles far up the silk, seen between and behind the two straight bare trees and the gnarled tree: no walls, eaves' ends or ridge ornaments show; willow and pine sprays cover its lower edge. The restyle paints only bare ground and trees here.
entities.vis: part: behind the two straight trees (12913-12930, 12964-12989) and the gnarled tree (13000-13080); lower edge under sprays
entities.note: Diamond tile lattice at u ~12800-13080 (its east part behind the gnarled tree's trunk), v ~100-315, lower edge ~v 300-315 at u 12820-13000 (zoom 2). Found from t1's left-to list ("the far diamond-tiled roof behind the elm-like trees, 12846-12997, v 147-294"). TWO READINGS: a separate building north of the big roof (recorded), or the upper part of S4b.bld.big_roof_hall_12990, whose visible top at (12990,380) is only where the sprays and the trunk stop hiding it (a gap of willow branches at v 315-380). Not the west end of S4b.bld.crowd_shop_13180: that roof's eave rises to the right from (13088,388), while this lower edge lies level at ~310. Base est (placeholder) ~100-200 px below the roof. SCALE CUES: none.

entities.name: long row of open shops and eating houses on the top street
entities.what: A long single-storey building along the north side of the top street, its tiled roof running off the top of the silk, its eave rising gently to the right; an open front on thin posts with a low railing, tables and benches inside and in front (an eating house or tea shop; the tile agents' props); at its east end a hatched panel (a mat screen or a lowered awning) hangs or leans.

entities.name: open shop with tables at the top edge, east of the long row
entities.what: A single-storey open-fronted shop or eating house at the very top of the silk, set a little further back than the long row's east end: a tiled roof running off the silk's top edge, its eave rising gently to the right, thin posts along the front, tables, benches and chairs inside (the tile agents' props); its east post stands against the small house with a gateway (structures_e's S4b.bld.top_shop_14224).
entities.vis: part: back off the silk's top edge; west end behind the hatched mat
entities.note: Eave (13860,80)->(14107,50); tiles above it to the silk's top edge (v ~15). Posts at ~13915 (v 70-145), ~13960, 14017 (v 60-120), 14067, 14100-14107 (v 50-118). Its west end meets the east end of S4b.bld.top_street_shops_13580 (eave ~105 there) behind the hatched mat (t3: S4b.prop.reed_mat_13870); the eave steps back here, so it is recorded separately. entities.name: wheelwright's shed (大车修理店?) with a lean-to on posts
entities.what: A narrow tiled shed whose roof, with a roll-tile ridge at its upper end, runs down to the right from the top of the wheelwright's yard, with a lower lean-to roof of lattice texture (mat or thin boards) continuing it on two posts; it opens west onto the square where the wheelwright works; a small pent-roofed lattice box (a window or a cupboard) under the upper roof's west end; a rail between the south post and the big tree; timber and a stand with a big round basket under the lean-to.
entities.vis: part: east side behind the big tree (13950-14050) and its branches
entities.src: 余辉: 车铺劳作; 名画记: 大车修理店 (pin 26, u 13620)
entities.note: UPPER ROOF: a strip ~60-80 px wide, its west edge (13715,469)->(13838,692) and east edge (13773,462)->(13896,700); roll tiles along its top end (13715-13775, v 458-480). LOWER LEAN-TO: lattice texture, west edge (13811,692)->(13950,862), east edge (13873,677)->(13981,846). Posts: 13873 (v 830-955) and 13965 (v 846-1031), their feet the bays. Under the upper roof's west end a small pent-roofed lattice box (t3: 13730-13763, v 587-637) in a light wall (13727-13780, v 562-631). A rail at v 932-942 runs from the south post (13965) east to the big tree (t3). Rafter ends along the lean-to at u 13840-13900, v 740-840. The shed is long and narrow along the down-right direction of its roofs; footprint est as a parallelogram from the roofs' top end to the two posts (builder choice for its width). Whether it is the wheelwright's own building or a lean-to of S4b.bld.roof_behind_trees_13980 is not settled. Its contents (timber pile 13650-13800 v 790-870, the stand with the big round basket 13800-13900 v 870-985, the wheel on the ground, the pole frame with the hanging basket at 13650-13700 v 450-650) are t3's props. SCALE CUES (px): post 13965 from the lean-to eave 846 to its foot 1031 = 185; post 13873 830-955 = 125. DEPTH DIRECTION (high lines): upper roof's edge slope +1.81, lean-to's +1.22 (down to the right).

entities.name: big south hall with a railed south gable and a high north gable (ridge rising up to the right)
entities.what: Large tiled hall south of the road whose ridge runs up to the right, like S4.bld.south_hall_12350 and its neighbours in the south row: a south gable facing the viewer with a tie beam, a king post and a railed balcony or lattice screen across its lower part on two posts; its west barge runs far down to the left to an eave at u ~13285; the ridge (a double line with roll tiles) rises to a high north gable peak with a finial near the road, the north barge descending to the right; tiles on its south-east slope only; walls and base hidden by the roofs in front and the silk's edge.
entities.vis: part: base below the roofs in front and the silk's edge; ridge partly behind the small hipped building
entities.note: SOUTH GABLE: apex (13705,1385); tie beam v ~1480 from 13560 to 13870; king post (13705, 1385-1480); a railed balcony or lattice v ~1500-1570 (13580-13870); a lattice railing under the west eave (13385-13560, v 1595-1640); posts at 13560 and 13870 run down from the tie beam behind the roof in front (S4b.bld.south_bottom_roof_13770). WEST BARGE/EAVE: a double band (13705,1385)->(13285,1605). RIDGE: from the south gable apex up to the right (13705,1385)->(13960,~1230)->(14145,1080), slope ~-0.69; north gable peak with a finial (14145,1080); north barge (14145,1080)->(14336,1241); the band west of the peak (13900,1223)->(14145,1082), -0.58, runs ~40 px above a second parallel line (at u 13900 ~1263): the ridge's double line, or the ridge and the north gable's west barge. The restyle draws one continuous ridge from (13285,1605) to the peak; structures_e reads the same hall (its note: south gable (13715,1370), north peak (14146,1115), "structures_w's"). ALTERNATIVE: two buildings, the gable hall ending at u ~13960 against a separate hall whose north gable is the peak; then the peak's building needs its own entity. BASE (placeholder, part 1's method): the ridge's ground line from under the south apex (~13705, 1780: apex + ~5 m) to under the north peak (~14145, 1475), +-250 px of u. It overlaps structures_e's S4b.bld.south_hall_long_14680 placeholder at u 14060-14395 (their roofs overlap in the picture: the north barge passes above the long hall's west hip at 14045-14173); the builder settles both. The small hipped building S4b.bld.south_hip_roof_13810 stands in front of its north-west side. SCALE CUES (px): south gable width at the tie beam 310 (13560-13870); apex to tie beam ~95. DEPTH DIRECTION (high): ridge ~-0.69 (-0.58 on the upper band), up to the RIGHT. MERGE: structures_e's reading of the same north gable, peak (14146, 1115), is the finial's foot; this entity's (14145, 1080) is its top (t4: ridge finial at u 14140-14160, v 1075-1110). Not a conflict.

entities.name: small hipped roof at the road's south edge (a man stands behind it)
entities.what: A small single-storey building with a hipped tiled roof of lattice texture just south of the road, in front of (north-west of) the big south hall; bracketed eave at its west end; a man stands on the road behind it, hidden from the waist down.
entities.vis: part: east part behind the big south hall's ridge
entities.note: West hip end (13643,1312)->(13730,1252); roof top (back edge) horizontal at v ~1200-1205 from 13810 to 13960; brackets under the west eave at (13660-13700, 1290-1320). The man behind it (13735-13785, head ~1160) is a tile agent's figure (t3), feet est ~1270 on the road. Base est (placeholder): each wall's foot ~190 px (~2.5 m) below the eave above it: the south eave at v ~1310 -> south wall ~1500, the back (north) edge at ~1200 -> north wall ~1390; it faces the road (north). It may instead be a gatehouse or porch of the gable hall.

entities.name: small gabled roof at the bottom edge (south row, west end)
entities.what: A small tiled roof at the silk's bottom edge east of the second palm-covered cart's rear: its gable, with a post and framing, faces west toward the cart; its ridge runs from the gable peak gently down to the right; walls and base below the silk's edge.
entities.vis: part: base below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Gable peak (13395,1625); west barge (13395,1625)->(13245,1750), its eave curving on down to the left at the silk's bottom edge to (13090,1762) (t2: a roof at 13070-13320, v 1678-1774); a post in the gable at ~13340 (v 1690-1750); ridge (13395,1625)->(13580,1675); tiles down to ~1760. A small pennant-like hanging at (13320-13350, 1620-1650) near the peak (a ridge ornament?). Base est at the silk edge (placeholder).

entities.name: gabled roof at the bottom edge in front of the big south hall's south gable
entities.what: A tiled roof at the silk's bottom edge in front of (south of) the big south hall's south gable: its ridge rises from the bottom left to a gable peak and its east barge runs down to the right; walls below the silk's edge.
entities.vis: part: base below the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Light ridge line (13565,1745)->(13785,1595), then a barge down to (13950,1650) (restyle the same); tiles of lattice texture between. It hides the big south hall's gable posts; it may instead be a porch roof of that hall. Base est at the silk edge (placeholder).
